title: Permanent Document Identity
notes: Assigns every Drill Log and Shot Diagram a permanent internal document UUID.
Keeps cloud identity unchanged when job names, dates, Shot IDs, Drill Log numbers, blasters, or employees are edited.
Migrates older local and cloud documents through their legacy cloud identity without abandoning existing records.
Stores permanent identity in JSON backups and restores it with the document.
Gives a Shot Diagram created from a Drill Log its own identity while recording the source Drill Log ID.
Preserves m40.2 Hole Edit rotation, the m40.1.3 desktop selection fix, and all existing cloud safety behavior.
